room.previewChat: Preview sessions use virtual partners. Chat with people is available in shared rooms.
room.sharedChat: Open a shared room to chat with the people in your session.
room.title: Study room
room.sayHi: Say hi to your study partners…
room.goalNotice: Your goal will be posted to the room when you join. Leave it empty to keep it private.
room.chatLimit: Please wait a moment before sending more messages.
room.notesPrompt: Jot down thoughts, questions, or reminders for yourself.
room.notesPrivate: These notes are private to you.
room.createDescription: Choose a name and how you want to use this room.
room.name: Room name
room.temporaryHint: Closes when your session finishes. It will not appear on your next login.
room.soloHint: Your private room remembers its desk and window view. Changes made while studying here are saved to this room.
room.sharedHint: Keep a reusable room with virtual partners, real people, or both. Anyone signed in with the URL or room ID can join.
room.deleteDescription: This removes the room from the Dashboard and closes shared access. Existing study history stays saved. People opening its link will see that the room is deleted.
room.deleted: Room with this ID is deleted.
